Actions

What aikyam fellows are doing. Each action belongs to a fellow, and each has a page of its own.

Every action name on this page is design's wording, and not one of them is real. “Listening Rooms”, “Girls on the Chenda”, and the rest were written so this page could be SEEN. ⛔ A programme name invented by a designer gets quoted back by a funder, printed in a report, and becomes the real name by accident — it has happened to better organisations than this one. The fellows, the story titles and the topics are real; the names of the actions are the organisation's to give, and so is the one sentence each that says what it does.

The same six, as a list

Identical markup. data-action-cards="list" on the container and nothing else changes. Which arrangement is right depends on how many actions there are: a grid reads as a collection, a list reads as a sequence, and with six of them either works.
